objects.description: Lightweight POD struct describing a native (embedded) preview inside an image container. Fields record byte position/size in the stream, pixel dimensions, and descriptive strings (filter and MIME type). Intended for internal use by PreviewManager.

objects.definition: using NativePreviewList = std::vector<NativePreview>;
objects.description: Type alias representing a collection of NativePreview entries, typically the previews discovered in an image.

objects.definition: enum PrintStructureOption { kpsNone, kpsBasic, kpsXMP, kpsRecursive, kpsIccProfile, kpsIptcErase };
objects.description: Enumeration of verbosity/options for printing the internal structure of image files (TIFF/IFD, XMP, ICC, etc.). Values control which sections and depth are printed.

Abstract base class and main entry point for Exiv2 image handling. Manages IO, metadata containers (Exif, IPTC, XMP), ICC profile, XMP packet, dimensions, and native previews. Subclasses implement format-specific read/write and MIME identification. Non-copyable; use UniquePtr for ownership. Construction requires an ImageType, supported-metadata bitmask, and a BasicIo instance.

objects.definition: using NewInstanceFct = Image::UniquePtr (*)(std::unique_ptr<BasicIo> io, bool create);
objects.description: Function pointer type for factory callbacks that construct Image instances from a BasicIo and a creation flag.

objects.definition: using IsThisTypeFct = bool (*)(BasicIo& iIo, bool advance);
objects.description: Function pointer type for probes that test whether provided IO contains a given image type; may advance the stream depending on the flag.
Static factory class for creating and identifying Image instances and IO backends. Provides multiple open/create overloads (by path, memory, BasicIo) and type probing utilities.

Represents a single Exif metadatum (tag), pairing an ExifKey with a Value and providing rich manipulation and access, including typed assignment, string parsing, serialization, and access to auxiliary data areas. Constructed from a key and optional value; copyable; owns its key and value. Destruction releases owned resources.

Const access wrapper for the Exif thumbnail embedded in IFD1. Provides read-only retrieval, file writing (optional), and format information. Holds a const reference to an ExifData container; does not modify metadata.

Mutable interface for managing the Exif thumbnail in IFD1. Inherits read-only access from ExifThumbC and adds methods to set JPEG thumbnails from file or memory with optional resolution tags, as well as erase. Holds a non-const reference to ExifData.

objects.definition: using ExifMetadata = std::list<Exifdatum>;
objects.description: Type alias for the container holding all Exifdatum elements, implemented as std::list<Exifdatum>. Used internally by ExifData as its storage.
Top-level container for Exif metadata, storing a collection of Exifdatum. Provides insertion, lookup, erase, sorting, and iteration. Owns the Exifdatum elements via its ExifMetadata list.

Stateless helper providing static methods to decode Exif data from a TIFF-based buffer into an ExifData container and to encode ExifData back into binary Exif format, either in-place when possible or by rebuilding into a Blob.

Represents a single IPTC dataset (metadatum), pairing an IptcKey with a Value and providing comprehensive accessors, converters, and serialization helpers. Constructible from a key and optional value; manages its own cloned Value. Copyable/assignable; destructor virtual via Metadatum. Unknowns: lifetime/ownership details for IptcKey::UniquePtr depend on IptcKey definition outside this header.

objects.definition: using IptcMetadata = std::vector<Iptcdatum>;
objects.description: Alias type for a vector container of Iptcdatum elements used to hold all IPTC metadata entries. Note: as a using-alias of a standard container, it is value-type, not polymorphic.

Top-level container managing a collection of Iptcdatum objects. Provides add/find/erase/sort operations, size queries, and serialization helpers (size, detectCharset, printStructure). Owns the underlying IptcMetadata vector.
Stateless helper for decoding/encoding IPTC IIM4 binary data to/from an IptcData container. Provides static decode/encode and a private marker constant.

Represents a single XMP property (metadatum) composed of an XmpKey and a Value with rich accessors and mutators. Uses Pimpl for ABI stability. Construct with a key and optional Value; supports assignment from strings, Value-derived types, bool, and other types via toString. Lifetime and cloning of Value are managed internally. copy() is not implemented and throws. Tag number and typeSize are nonsensical and return 0.

Top-level container for XMP metadata entries. Manages a collection of Xmpdatum and an optional serialized XMP packet. Provides insertion, deletion, search, sort, and iterator access. Also stores and controls use of a raw XMP packet string.

Stateless utility for decoding and encoding XMP packets and managing namespace registration with the Adobe XMP Toolkit. Provides format flags, initialization/termination hooks, and an optional thread-safety lock callback type.
Bitmask enum defining options that control XMP packet serialization format used by XmpParser::encode().

objects.definition: using XmpLockFct = void (*)(void* pLockData, bool lockUnlock);
objects.description: Function pointer typedef for a lock/unlock callback used to serialize namespace registration in XmpParser initialization.

objects.definition: using XmpMetadata = std::vector<Xmpdatum>;
objects.description: Alias for a vector of Xmpdatum serving as the underlying container type used by XmpData.

Abstract base class for all metadata value types. Provides uniform interface for reading from buffers/strings, writing, conversions to primitive forms, cloning, and optional auxiliary data area handling.
Concrete Value holding arbitrary/undefined byte data. Supports reading from buffers or space-separated integer strings and provides conversions by interpreting raw bytes per element.
Abstract helper base for string-backed Value implementations. Stores a std::string and provides default behaviors for reading/writing and conversions.
Concrete Value for generic string metadata (may be multi-byte encoded). No automatic encoding conversions; caller handles encoding.
Concrete Value for null-terminated ASCII strings. Ensures trailing NUL on read and writes up to first NUL.

Value for Exif UserComment. Handles charset prefixes and decoding strategy; stores byte order used when reading. Utility nested types include CharsetId enum, CharsetTable struct, and CharsetInfo lookup class.
Abstract base for XMP value types. Tracks XMP array/struct semantics and provides size/copy for string-like payloads in derived classes.
Value for simple XMP properties and unparsed complex nodes. Stores text and supports optional type keywords (Alt/Bag/Seq/Struct) via read().
Value for simple XMP arrays (Bag, Seq, Alt) without qualifiers. Holds vector of strings and appends items on successive reads.
Value for XMP language alternatives. Stores a map from language tag to text, with case-insensitive comparator and helpers to get default (x-default) or specific language entries.
Value for ISO 8601 dates (CCYYMMDD). Provides parsing from strings/buffers, accessors for Date struct, and conversions to numerical time forms.
Value for ISO 8601 times (HHMMSS±HHMM). Stores local time and timezone offset; converts to seconds in day UTC and other numeric forms.

Template Value implementation for basic scalar types including integers, rationals, and floats/doubles. Stores a vector<T> plus optional data area. Provides read/write, conversions, and cloning. Type aliases define concrete instantiations for common Exiv2 formats.
Static utility class inside CommentValue providing lookup between charset identifiers, names, and codes for Exif comments.
POD struct describing a charset entry (id, human-readable name, and code) used by CommentValue::CharsetInfo.
Helper struct representing a calendar date used by DateValue for storage and access.
Helper struct representing a time-of-day and timezone offset used by TimeValue.

objects.definition: enum XmpArrayType { xaNone, xaAlt, xaBag, xaSeq };
objects.description: Enum describing XMP array kind: none, Alt, Bag, or Seq, used by XmpValue and derivatives.

objects.definition: enum XmpStruct { xsNone, xsStruct };
objects.description: Enum indicating whether an XMP value represents a structure.

objects.definition: enum CharsetId { ascii, jis, unicode, undefined, invalidCharsetId, lastCharsetId };
objects.description: Enum of Exif comment charset identifiers used by CommentValue.

objects.description: Unsigned rational number represented as a pair of numerator and denominator (both 32-bit unsigned). Used for Exif RATIONAL values.

objects.definition: using Rational = std::pair<int32_t, int32_t>;
objects.description: Signed rational number represented as a pair of numerator and denominator (both 32-bit signed). Used for Exif SRATIONAL values.
Endianness selector for reading/writing multi-byte values: invalid, little-endian, or big-endian.
Indicates the write method used by TIFF parsers: intrusive or non-intrusive.
Bitmask identifiers for types of metadata present in an image (Exif, IPTC, XMP, ICC profile, comments).
Mode flags for metadata support: none, read, write, read/write.

objects.description: Container of raw binary data bytes (vector of Exiv2::byte). Used as a flexible buffer.
Static utility class providing name/id/size lookup for Exiv2 TypeId values.
Small RAII-like binary buffer wrapper around Blob providing allocation, resizing, byte-wise read/write with endianness, and convenience accessors. Primarily used as a temporary data buffer.

Abstract interface for binary I/O sources with FILE-like semantics. Provides read/write/seek/mmap and metadata utility methods. Subclasses implement concrete storage (file, memory, remote). bigBlock_ is a raw pointer populated by mmap().

objects.definition: using UniquePtr = std::unique_ptr<BasicIo>;
objects.description: Type alias for an owning unique_ptr to BasicIo instances.

objects.definition: enum Position { beg, cur, end };
objects.description: Seek origin enumeration used by BasicIo::seek to indicate start, current, or end positions.
RAII helper that closes a referenced BasicIo on destruction. Useful for exception-safe cleanup.
Concrete BasicIo implementation for filesystem files. Supports opening with modes, reading/writing, memory mapping, and path management. Uses Pimpl (Impl) for platform-specific details.
BasicIo implementation backed by an in-memory buffer with copy-on-write semantics. Always logically open; supports direct buffer access via mmap(). Pimpl hides storage details.

Specialized FileIo that sources input from stdin or a data URI. Creates a temporary file to hold the data; destructor removes temp file if still marked temporary. Provides helper to materialize data to a file.
Abstract BasicIo for remote resources (HTTP/SSH/etc). Manages block-mapped remote data, on-demand population, and efficient diff-based writes where supported. Uses pimpl for implementation details.
RemoteIo implementation for HTTP protocol with configurable block size for on-demand fetching. Details hidden via HttpImpl.
Referenced buffer type returned by read operations and used in helpers; its definition is not present in this header (presumably in types.hpp). Ignored for ownership; only referenced here.
Referenced error code enum/class used by readOrThrow/seekOrThrow. Definition not present in this header (likely in error.hpp).

Abstract base class representing a metadata key (family.group.tag). Provides accessors for family, group, tag name/label/description and numeric tag id, plus cloning and stream output helper. It is an interface; construction is via subclasses elsewhere. Details about lifetime and concrete implementations are not provided here.

Abstract base class for a single metadata item (Exif/IPTC/XMP). Defines interface for setting and retrieving the associated Value, printing/writing, type information, counts and conversions. It is an interface; concrete implementations are provided elsewhere.

objects.definition: using PrintFct = std::ostream& (*)(std::ostream&, const Value&, const ExifData* pExifData);
objects.description: Function pointer type to tag-value print callbacks. Points to a function that formats a Value (optionally using ExifData context) into an ostream and returns the ostream.

objects.description: Function pointer type returning a pointer to the first element of a null-terminated (or otherwise convention-defined) array of TagInfo structures for a group.

objects.definition:
struct EXIV2API TagInfo {
  uint16_t tag_;         //!< Tag
  const char* name_;     //!< One word tag label
  const char* title_;    //!< Tag title
  const char* desc_;     //!< Short tag description
  IfdId ifdId_;          //!< Link to the (preferred) IFD
  SectionId sectionId_;  //!< Section id
  TypeId typeId_;        //!< Type id
  int16_t count_;        //!< The number of values (not bytes!), 0=any, -1=count not known.
  PrintFct printFct_;    //!< Pointer to tag print function
};
objects.description: Metadata describing a single Exif tag: numeric id, names, description, owning IfdId and SectionId, expected value type and count, and a printer callback.
Static utility class providing access to built-in Exif group and tag reference data and helper queries/printing.

Concrete Key for Exif metadata. Parses and represents Exif keys, provides accessors for tag/group, and uses a Pimpl for internals. Offers copying, cloning, and index management. Requires Key base type from metadatum.hpp.

objects.definition: using PreviewId = int;
objects.description: Type alias identifying the type/category of a preview image. It is an integer identifier; concrete semantics depend on the implementation elsewhere.
Holds metadata describing a preview image: MIME type, file extension, byte size, pixel dimensions, and a type identifier.

objects.definition: using PreviewPropertiesList = std::vector<PreviewProperties>;
objects.description: Container of PreviewProperties entries representing all discovered preview images, typically sorted by area (width*height).

Owns a preview image’s metadata and data buffer. Provides read-only access to bytes and properties, and optionally writes to a file when filesystem support is enabled. Constructible only by PreviewManager via a private constructor.
Extracts preview images from an Exiv2::Image: enumerates available previews and materializes PreviewImage instances for chosen properties. Holds a reference to the source Image.

Holds metadata describing a single IPTC record: its numeric record ID, short name, and a human-readable description. Likely used as entries in static lookup tables for record information. Construction is not public API; instances are typically provided by the library.

objects.definition:
struct EXIV2API DataSet {
  uint16_t number_;        //!< Dataset number
  const char* name_;       //!< Dataset name
  const char* title_;      //!< Dataset title or label
  const char* desc_;       //!< Dataset description
  bool mandatory_;         //!< True if dataset is mandatory
  bool repeatable_;        //!< True if dataset is repeatable
  uint32_t minbytes_;      //!< Minimum number of bytes
  uint32_t maxbytes_;      //!< Maximum number of bytes
  TypeId type_;            //!< Exiv2 default type
  uint16_t recordId_;      //!< Record id
  const char* photoshop_;  //!< Photoshop string
};
objects.description: Describes an IPTC dataset, including identifiers, human-readable metadata, constraints (mandatory/repeatable, size limits), default Exiv2 TypeId, and Photoshop alias. Intended for static reference tables; objects are not constructed directly by users.

Static utility/registry class that defines IPTC record and dataset identifiers and exposes lookup APIs for names, titles, descriptions, Photoshop aliases, repeatability, data types, and record lists. No instances are intended to be created. The class also provides functions to iterate/print dataset definitions.

Concrete Key implementation for IPTC metadata. It parses/builds key strings in the form "Iptc.RecordName.DataSetName" and provides access to tag, record, and textual properties. Constructible from a key string or from dataset and record IDs; throws Error on invalid inputs. Cloning supported via UniquePtr.

Logging helper class for building and emitting log messages based on a configurable level and handler callback. Intended for temporary use via macros EXV_DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR. Not copyable; construct with a Level, stream into os(), and on destruction it forwards the accumulated message to the current handler if the level threshold permits.
Enumeration of log severity levels used by Exiv2::LogMsg. Higher values suppress lower-severity messages when configured as the active threshold.

Exception type for Exiv2 operations. Stores an ErrorCode and up to three stringified arguments, assembles a descriptive message via setMsg(), and exposes it via what(). Inherits from std::exception.

objects.definition: enum XmpCategory { xmpInternal, xmpExternal };
objects.description: Enumeration describing whether an XMP property is internal to files or external. Values: xmpInternal, xmpExternal.

Describes a single XMP property: its name, label, value type (informational), default Exiv2 TypeId, category (internal/external), and a description. Provides comparison by property name. Lifetime/ownership of pointed-to strings is external and not specified here.

Maps an XMP schema namespace to its preferred prefix and metadata. Contains comparators for matching by namespace string or prefix. Holds C-string pointers for namespace, prefix, description, and a pointer to an array/list of XmpPropertyInfo entries (read-only).

Static utility/registry class for XMP namespaces and properties. Provides query, formatting, and registration/unregistration of namespaces and property metadata. Contains a static mutex for synchronization and a static namespace registry map.

Concrete Key subtype representing an XMP metadata key. Can be constructed from a full key string or from schema prefix and property name. Provides accessors for key components and metadata and uses a Pimpl for implementation details.
direct_api_constructors: Exiv2::XmpKey::XmpKey(const std::string& prefix, const std::string& property)

objects.definition: using NsRegistry = std::map<std::string, XmpNsInfo>;
objects.description: Type alias for the namespace registry map used by XmpProperties. Maps schema prefix strings to XmpNsInfo records.
Small helper struct used to compare or lookup namespace entries by prefix string within XmpNsInfo and XmpProperties lookup APIs.
Helper struct used to compare or lookup namespace entries by namespace URI string within XmpNsInfo and XmpProperties lookup APIs.

objects.definition: enum EnVar { envHTTPPOST = 0, envTIMEOUT = 1 };
objects.description: Enumeration of supported environment-variable keys used by Exiv2 helpers. The known values are envHTTPPOST and envTIMEOUT.

objects.definition: enum Protocol { pFile = 0, pHttp, pFtp, pHttps, pSftp, pFileUri, pDataUri, pStdin };
objects.description: Enumeration of supported URI/file access protocols recognized by utility functions. Values cover file, HTTP(S), FTP/SFTP, file/data URIs, and stdin.

Lightweight container for URL components (protocol, host, path, port, query string, username, password) in the Exiv2 namespace. Provides static helpers to parse a URL string into a Uri instance and to decode percent-encoded components. No ownership semantics beyond standard strings are implied; construction is via value semantics and the static Parse method.

Abstract helper base class for accessing JPEG-like images within Exiv2. Provides common metadata IO, structure printing, and helpers for JPEG segment traversal. Subclasses must implement type detection and header writing. Holds derived information about number of color components and SOF encoding process.

Concrete image class for standard JPEG files. Implements MIME type query, JPEG type detection, and writing a minimal JPEG header. Exposes the number of color components and SOF-derived encoding process as accessors.
Concrete image class for Exiv2 .exv container files that embed metadata using a JPEG-like marker structure. Implements MIME type query, EXV type detection, and writing a minimal EXV header/signature.

Concrete Image subclass providing read/write and structure-printing support for PNG images in Exiv2. It owns/uses a BasicIo for I/O and buffers metadata for writing via doWriteMetadata. Construction opens an existing PNG or creates a new one; callers should verify good() on the Image base after construction.

Concrete Image subclass providing minimal support for Windows BMP files. It currently only reads basic properties (width/height) and does not support writing metadata or setting Exif/Iptc/comment. Constructed with ownership of a BasicIo; callers should check good() after construction. Overrides readMetadata and mimeType; write/set* operations throw errors indicating unsupported functionality.

Concrete Image subclass providing access to TIFF images. Manages reading and writing of TIFF metadata and exposes basic properties (MIME type, pixel dimensions). It also offers a structure printer for debugging. No TIFF comment support. Ownership of the BasicIo passed to the constructor is transferred to the image object.

Stateless helper providing static methods to decode/encode TIFF-formatted metadata buffers to and from Exif, IPTC, and XMP containers. Used by image classes to process TIFF data. Wraps an internal worker (Internal::TiffParserWorker).

Concrete Image subclass providing access to JPEG-2000 (JP2) images. It supports reading/writing metadata, printing the internal box structure for debugging, and encoding the JP2 header to embed an ICC profile. Brand code of the file is stored in brand_. Construction takes ownership of a BasicIo via unique_ptr. Destruction/virtual behavior is managed by the Image base class. Specific threading guarantees are not given; printStructure is explicitly not thread-safe.

Concrete Image subclass providing read/write access to Adobe Photoshop (PSD) image metadata. Constructs from a BasicIo owned via unique_ptr. Supports reading/writing EXIF, IPTC, and XMP blocks and exposes the PSD MIME type. setComment is not supported and will throw. Internal helpers handle resource block parsing and metadata serialization.

Concrete Image subclass providing read/write access to PGF images, including Exif and IPTC metadata handling. It owns no external resources directly; construction requires a BasicIo for I/O. Endianness handling is tracked via bSwap_. Public API overrides Image methods to read/write metadata and report MIME type.

Concrete Image subclass providing access to Encapsulated PostScript (EPS) images. Offers metadata read/write via the Image interface; setting a comment is explicitly unsupported and will throw. Constructed with ownership of a BasicIo. Behavior details beyond the declared interface are defined in the implementation and not present in this header.

Concrete Image subclass providing read access for Minolta MRW raw images. Supports Exif metadata directly and reads IPTC from embedded Exif when present. Writing metadata and setting Exif/Iptc/comment are declared but documented as unsupported and expected to throw errors. Constructed with ownership of a BasicIo for file I/O. Pixel dimensions and mime type can be queried.

Concrete Image subclass providing access to Canon CRW (CIFF) images. Supports Exif metadata and image comment; IPTC is not supported and setIptcData will throw. Constructed with ownership of a BasicIo for reading/writing. Use mimeType, pixelWidth, and pixelHeight accessors; call readMetadata/writeMetadata to load/store metadata.

Stateless helper for decoding/encoding Canon CRW (CIFF) image metadata. Provides static entry points to parse raw buffers into a CrwImage or to encode a CrwImage's metadata back into a binary CRW buffer.

Concrete Image subclass providing read/write access to Canon CR2 raw files. Supports Exif directly; IPTC is read via Exif when present. It overrides Image interfaces for metadata IO, structure printing, comment handling (unsupported for CR2), and basic image properties. Construction takes ownership of a BasicIo via unique_ptr; callers must check good() on the base Image after construction to verify success. Destruction/ownership follow Image semantics.

Stateless helper with static functions to decode CR2 buffers into metadata containers and to encode metadata back to CR2 format. Intended for use by Image implementations handling CR2. No instances are required or typically created.

Concrete Image subclass providing read-only access to Fujifilm RAF raw images. It supports reading Exif metadata (with IPTC derived from Exif if present). Writing/modifying metadata and setting comments are declared but documented as unsupported and expected to throw at runtime. Construction takes ownership of a BasicIo via unique_ptr. Methods expose MIME type and pixel dimensions, and a structure-printing utility.

Concrete Image subclass for Panasonic RW2 raw images. Supports reading metadata; writing is declared but documented as unsupported and expected to throw at runtime. Provides format-specific behavior for structure printing, dimensions, and MIME type. Constructor takes ownership of a BasicIo via unique_ptr.

Stateless helper providing RW2 format parsing. Currently only exposes a static decode function to extract metadata from a memory buffer into Exif, IPTC, and XMP containers, returning the detected byte order.

Concrete image class for Olympus ORF raw files. Inherits from TiffImage to provide TIFF-based parsing/handling. Supports Exif directly; IPTC is derived from Exif if present. setComment is unsupported and will throw. Construct with a BasicIo and a create flag; check good() on the base Image after construction to verify success.
Stateless helper for decoding/encoding ORF-format metadata to and from Exiv2 metadata containers. Provides static decode and encode functions used by image classes.

Concrete Image subclass providing minimal support for raw TARGA (TGA) images. As documented, this stub currently reads only width and height; writing metadata and setting Exif/Iptc/comment are unsupported and throw errors. Construct with a BasicIo owner; check good() after construction. Use mimeType() to get the format’s MIME type.

Concrete Image subclass providing metadata read/write and parsing utilities for QuickTime/MP4 container files. It decodes various atom types and populates XMP/metadata fields. Construct with a BasicIo that the object takes ownership of. Public API overrides Image::readMetadata, writeMetadata, and mimeType. Internal helpers parse specific atoms; recursion depth is limited by max_recursion_depth_.

Concrete Image subclass providing metadata reading/writing for ASF (Advanced Systems Format) video files. Offers ASF-specific block decoding and helpers. Constructed with ownership of a BasicIo. Provides MIME type, read/write operations, and ASF header/tag parsing routines. Includes nested helper types GUIDTag and HeaderReader. Destruction/ownership follows Image base semantics; no custom destructor declared here.

Nested helper class representing a GUID used within ASF structures. Stores GUID components and supports construction from parts or from a raw 16-byte array (little-endian), comparison, ordering, and string formatting.

objects.definition:
enum matroskaTypeEnum : char {
  String = 's',
  Integer = 'i',
  UInteger = 'u',
  Date = 'd',
  InternalField = 'n',
  Boolean = 'o',
  Binary = 'b',
  Master = 'm',
  Float = 'f',
  Utf8 = '8',
  UndefinedType = 'z',
};
objects.description: Scoped underlying-char enum describing Matroska element value types used by the tag lookup in the Matroska module.
Scoped underlying-char enum indicating how a Matroska element should be handled (processed, skipped, composite, or undefined).
Helper struct for Matroska tags table entries. Stores element ID, label, value type, and processing directive; offers comparison and helper methods.

Image subclass to read/write metadata from Matroska video files (MKV/WebM). Manages parsing of EBML blocks and decoding various tag types into Exiv2 metadata. Construction takes ownership of a BasicIo via unique_ptr.
Alias type returned by factory newMkvInstance; canonical definition is outside this header. Only referenced here; precise typedef unknown in this file.

Class to access RIFF video files. Derived from Exiv2::Image, it parses RIFF/AVI container structures, reads/writes metadata (EXIF, XMP, INFO), and exposes a RIFF-specific MIME type. Construction takes ownership of a BasicIo. Provides helpers to parse RIFF lists/chunks and compute duration/aspect ratio. Inner helper class HeaderReader reads chunk/list IDs and sizes.

GIF Image reader class within namespace Exiv2 providing access to raw GIF images and metadata handling hooks. It derives from Image and overrides core interfaces. Constructor takes ownership of a BasicIo via std::unique_ptr. write/set* operations are documented as unsupported and will throw; readMetadata reads metadata; mimeType returns the MIME type for GIF. No additional members are declared here.

Helper struct in namespace Exiv2 providing static utilities for working with Photoshop Information Resource Blocks (IRBs) inside APP13 data. It exposes identifiers for common IRB markers and functions to validate, locate, and modify IPTC- and preview-related IRBs. This type is a stateless utility; no instances are required or expected. Construction/destruction is trivial; all APIs are static. Details of DataBuf, byte, and IptcData are defined elsewhere.

Concrete Image subclass providing access to XMP sidecar files (files that contain only XMP metadata). It owns a BasicIo via unique_ptr passed to the constructor. It overrides reading/writing of metadata and disallows image comments. The public member dates_ stores date-related metadata in a Dictionary. Destruction/ownership follow Image semantics; lifetime is typically via Image::UniquePtr.

objects.definition:
namespace Exiv2 {

  jpeg,

};
}  // namespace Exiv2
objects.description: Scoped enum listing supported image/container formats in the Exiv2 namespace. Values cover common raw formats (arw, cr2, nef, etc.), raster formats (bmp, gif, jpeg, png, tiff, webp), sidecar/metadata (xmp), and some containers (asf, bmff, riff, mkv, qtime). No associated methods or constructors; typical usage is as a discriminator for format handling in APIs. Underlying type is implementation-defined unless fixed elsewhere. Destruction has no semantics; copyable/movable as a trivial enum.
Common non-templated base for all slice implementations; holds [begin,end) bounds, provides size() and bounds checking. Throws on invalid construction or access.

Concrete Image subclass providing read/write and structural inspection for WebP images (still or animated). It owns a BasicIo supplied at construction and overrides Image operations to handle WebP chunks (VP8/VP8L/VP8X, EXIF, XMP, ICC, ANIM/ANMF). Construction does not guarantee success; callers should check good() after creating via the constructor or factory. Some setters (comment, IPTC) are explicitly unsupported and will throw. Static constants expose WebP tag sizes/flags and chunk identifiers.

functions.name: Exiv2::versionNumber
functions.description: Returns the Exiv2 runtime library version as a 32-bit integer, typically encoded as (major << 16) | (minor << 8) | patch. Use for simple numeric comparisons at runtime.
requirements: May be called at any time after the Exiv2 library is loaded.
No arguments; no pre-initialization required.
Return value is a packed version; callers should decode using shifts/masks consistent with EXIV2_MAKE_VERSION.

functions.name: Exiv2::versionString
functions.description: Returns the Exiv2 runtime library version in dotted string form, e.g., "0.25.0" (major.minor.patch). Useful for display or logging.
requirements: May be called at any time after the Exiv2 library is loaded.
Returned string format is major.minor.patch; exact formatting beyond that (e.g., leading zeros) is not specified.

functions.name: Exiv2::versionNumberHexString
functions.description: Returns the Exiv2 runtime version as a fixed-length 6-character hexadecimal string representing major, minor, and patch bytes (MMmmpp). Suitable for compact display or tagging.
requirements: May be called at any time after the Exiv2 library is loaded.
String length is fixed at 6; callers should not assume any prefix like "0x".

functions.name: Exiv2::version
functions.description: Returns a C-style string with the Exiv2 runtime version, e.g., "0.27.0.2". The fourth field (tweak) may be used for pre-releases/RCs.
requirements: May be called at any time after the Exiv2 library is loaded.
Pointer remains owned by the library; caller must not free it.
String is null-terminated; lifetime/stability across calls is unspecified—copy if long-term storage is needed.

functions.name: Exiv2::testVersion
functions.signature: EXIV2API bool Exiv2::testVersion(uint32_t major, uint32_t minor, uint32_t patch);
functions.description: Checks whether the Exiv2 library available at runtime is the same as or newer than the specified version (major.minor.patch). Returns true if runtime >= requested.
requirements: Inputs major, minor, and patch are unsigned 32-bit integers; typical usage is small non-negative values.
May be called at any time after the Exiv2 library is loaded.
Comparison semantics are lexicographic on (major, minor, patch) consistent with EXIV2_MAKE_VERSION packing.

functions.name: Exiv2::dumpLibraryInfo
functions.signature: EXIV2API void Exiv2::dumpLibraryInfo(std::ostream& os, const std::vector<std::regex>& keys);
functions.description: Writes verbose library information (implements the exiv2 "--version --verbose" output) to the provided output stream. The optional regex keys can be used to filter which entries are shown.
requirements: os must reference a valid, writable std::ostream; failures to write will be reflected in the stream state.
keys may be empty to show all information; each std::regex must be successfully constructed before the call.
Function performs output only; no return value—callers should check os.fail() or stream state for I/O errors after the call.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::Image
functions.signature: Exiv2::Image::Image(Exiv2::ImageType type, uint16_t supportedMetadata, std::unique_ptr<Exiv2::BasicIo> io)
functions.description: Constructor for the abstract Image base class. Initializes the image with a specific image type, a bitmap of supported metadata types, and takes ownership of a BasicIo for image data access.
requirements: io must be a valid std::unique_ptr owning a usable Exiv2::BasicIo; ownership is transferred to the Image instance.
type must be a valid Exiv2::ImageType for the concrete subclass.
supportedMetadata is a bitmap of supported metadata types; values depend on library constants.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::~Image
functions.description: Virtual destructor for Image. Ensures proper cleanup via base pointers.
requirements: No special requirements for callers; destruction should occur via owning pointer (e.g., UniquePtr).

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::printStructure
functions.signature: virtual void Exiv2::Image::printStructure(std::ostream& out, Exiv2::PrintStructureOption option = Exiv2::kpsNone, size_t depth = 0)
functions.description: Prints the structure of the image file for debugging (intended for exiv2 -pS). Not thread-safe.
requirements: May throw Error if file read fails or image data is invalid.
The stream out should be usable; on some platforms, set it to binary mode for correct output.
Not thread safe; avoid concurrent calls on the same Image.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::readMetadata
functions.description: Pure virtual: Read all metadata supported by the specific image format into internal buffers (Exif, IPTC, XMP, etc.). Clears existing buffered metadata before reading.
requirements: Will throw Error if opening/reading fails or data is not valid for the image type.
After return, even if no metadata is found, accessors are valid but may be empty; callers should check container sizes before accessing values.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::writeMetadata
functions.description: Pure virtual: Write buffered metadata back to the image. Creates, replaces, or removes metadata sections based on currently buffered values or raw XMP packet settings.
requirements: May throw Error if the operation fails.
Existing metadata sections are overwritten or removed based on buffered state; ensure buffers (Exif/Iptc/Xmp) contain intended content before calling.
If writeXmpFromPacket() is set, XMP is written from the raw packet; otherwise from parsed XMP data.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::setExifData
functions.description: Replace buffered Exif metadata with a copy of the provided ExifData. Changes are not persisted until writeMetadata() is called.
requirements: exifData must hold well-formed Exif entries for the target format; invalid content may later cause writeMetadata() to fail.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::clearExifData
functions.description: Erase any buffered Exif data. Removal from the actual image occurs on writeMetadata().
requirements: None beyond typical object validity.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::setIptcData
functions.description: Replace buffered IPTC metadata with a copy of the provided IptcData. Not written until writeMetadata() is called.
requirements: iptcData must contain well-formed IPTC entries; invalid content may cause writeMetadata() to fail.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::clearIptcData
functions.description: Erase any buffered IPTC data. Actual removal occurs on writeMetadata().

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::setXmpPacket
functions.description: Set a raw XMP packet string into the buffer. Subsequent writeMetadata() operations will write XMP from this packet (writeXmpFromPacket will be set accordingly).
requirements: xmpPacket should contain a well-formed XMP packet; malformed content can cause writeMetadata() to fail.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::clearXmpPacket
functions.description: Erase the buffered raw XMP packet. Does not affect parsed XMP data; subsequent writes from packet vs. parsed XMP depend on flag settings.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::setXmpData
functions.description: Replace buffered parsed XMP data with a copy. Subsequent writeMetadata() re-encodes and writes from parsed data and updates the raw packet buffer.
requirements: xmpData should be valid/encodable XMP; otherwise writeMetadata() may fail.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::clearXmpData
functions.description: Erase buffered parsed XMP data. Subsequent writeMetadata() will write from the raw packet if present/selected.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::setComment
functions.description: Set the image comment in the buffer; written to the image on writeMetadata().
requirements: comment content and encoding should meet the target format’s constraints; invalid content can cause writeMetadata() to fail for some formats.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::clearComment
functions.description: Erase the buffered image comment. Removal from the actual image occurs on writeMetadata().

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::setIccProfile
functions.signature: virtual void Exiv2::Image::setIccProfile(Exiv2::DataBuf&& iccProfile, bool bTestValid = true)
functions.description: Set/replace the buffered ICC profile from a DataBuf. Optionally validates the profile contents. Persisted on writeMetadata().
requirements: iccProfile is moved into the Image; caller must not use it after passing.
If bTestValid is true, the function will validate the buffer; invalid profiles may trigger errors (at set time or later on write).

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::appendIccProfile
functions.signature: void Exiv2::Image::appendIccProfile(const uint8_t* bytes, size_t size, bool bTestValid)
functions.description: Append raw bytes to the buffered ICC profile, optionally validating the growing profile.
requirements: If size > 0, bytes must be a valid non-null pointer to at least size bytes.
If bTestValid is true, appended data should maintain a valid ICC profile; invalid content may cause exceptions (now or later via checkIccProfile/write).

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::checkIccProfile
functions.description: Validate the ICC profile size field at the beginning of the buffered profile and throw if inconsistent.
requirements: An ICC profile must be present; otherwise behavior depends on implementation (likely throws on empty/too small buffer).

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::clearIccProfile
functions.description: Erase the buffered ICC profile. Removal from the image occurs on writeMetadata().

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::iccProfileDefined
functions.description: Return whether an ICC profile is currently buffered/defined in the Image instance.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::iccProfile
functions.description: Access the buffered ICC profile as a read-only DataBuf reference.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid while the Image object remains alive and until the ICC profile buffer is modified/cleared.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::setMetadata
functions.description: Copy all existing metadata (Exif, IPTC, XMP, comment, ICC, etc.) from another Image into internal buffers. Not written until writeMetadata().
requirements: image must be a valid Image containing the metadata to copy.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::clearMetadata
functions.description: Erase all buffered metadata (Exif, IPTC, XMP, comment, ICC). Actual image data is not changed until writeMetadata() is called.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::exifData
functions.description: Return a modifiable reference to the buffered ExifData container. Written to the image by writeMetadata().
requirements: Modifications should maintain valid Exif structure; invalid changes may cause writeMetadata() to fail.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::exifData
functions.description: Return a read-only reference to the buffered ExifData.
requirements: Reference remains valid while the Image object is alive and Exif buffer is not modified.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::iptcData
functions.description: Return a modifiable reference to the buffered IPTC data container. Written to the image by writeMetadata().
requirements: Ensure entries are valid for IPTC; invalid changes may cause writeMetadata() to fail.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::iptcData
functions.description: Return a read-only reference to the buffered IPTC data.
requirements: Reference remains valid while the Image object is alive and IPTC buffer is not modified.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::xmpData
functions.description: Return a modifiable reference to the buffered parsed XMP data container. Written to the image by writeMetadata() (encoding to a raw packet).
requirements: Ensure entries are valid/encodable XMP; invalid changes may cause writeMetadata() to fail.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::xmpData
functions.description: Return a read-only reference to the buffered parsed XMP data.
requirements: Reference remains valid while the Image object is alive and XMP buffer is not modified.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::xmpPacket
functions.description: Return a modifiable reference to the buffered raw XMP packet string.
requirements: Caller must keep the string in a valid XMP packet format if writeXmpFromPacket() is used to write from packet.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::xmpPacket
functions.description: Return a read-only reference to the buffered raw XMP packet string.
requirements: Reference remains valid while the Image object is alive and the packet buffer is not modified.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::writeXmpFromPacket
functions.description: Control whether writeMetadata() writes XMP from the buffered raw packet (true) or from parsed XMP data (false). May be set implicitly by other setters/clearers.
requirements: No special requirements; choose mode consistent with how XMP buffers are maintained.
If the library is built without XMP support, default is true and may never change (note from docs).

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::writeXmpFromPacket
functions.description: Return the current setting that controls whether XMP is written from the raw packet (true) or from parsed XMP data (false).

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::setByteOrder
functions.description: Set the byte order to use when new Exif metadata is created/encoded. If image already has Exif, its byte order is used. Defaults to little-endian if not set.
requirements: byteOrder should be a valid Exiv2::ByteOrder (not invalidByteOrder) for effect.
May not apply to all formats; setting may be ignored depending on image type.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::printTiffStructure
functions.signature: void Exiv2::Image::printTiffStructure(Exiv2::BasicIo& io, std::ostream& out, Exiv2::PrintStructureOption option, size_t depth, size_t offset = 0)
functions.description: Print the TIFF structure of the data in the provided BasicIo to the output stream, for debugging/inspection.
requirements: May throw Error if reading fails or data is invalid.
io must be readable and positioned appropriately; function may (re)interpret from offset.
out must be a valid stream; may need binary mode on some platforms.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::printIFDStructure
functions.signature: void Exiv2::Image::printIFDStructure(Exiv2::BasicIo& io, std::ostream& out, Exiv2::PrintStructureOption option, size_t start, bool bSwap, char c, size_t depth)
functions.description: Print the structure of a TIFF IFD starting at position 'start' with optional byte swapping control, for debugging/inspection.
requirements: io must be readable at the IFD position indicated by start.
bSwap indicates whether byte swapping is required; supply correct value based on endianness.
out must be valid; may need binary mode.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::isBigEndianPlatform
functions.description: Return true if the host platform is big-endian.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::isLittleEndianPlatform
functions.description: Return true if the host platform is little-endian.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::isStringType
functions.description: Return whether the provided TIFF/IFD type code corresponds to a string type. Details are library-internal.
requirements: type should be a valid TIFF tag type code.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::isShortType
functions.description: Return whether the provided TIFF/IFD type code corresponds to a 16-bit short type.
requirements: type should be a valid TIFF tag type code.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::isLongType
functions.description: Return whether the provided TIFF/IFD type code corresponds to a 32-bit long type.
requirements: type should be a valid TIFF tag type code.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::isLongLongType
functions.description: Return whether the provided TIFF/IFD type code corresponds to a 64-bit long long type.
requirements: type should be a valid TIFF tag type code.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::isRationalType
functions.description: Return whether the provided TIFF/IFD type code corresponds to a rational type.
requirements: type should be a valid TIFF tag type code.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::is2ByteType
functions.description: Return whether the provided TIFF/IFD type code has a 2-byte width.
requirements: type should be a valid TIFF tag type code.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::is4ByteType
functions.description: Return whether the provided TIFF/IFD type code has a 4-byte width.
requirements: type should be a valid TIFF tag type code.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::is8ByteType
functions.description: Return whether the provided TIFF/IFD type code has an 8-byte width.
requirements: type should be a valid TIFF tag type code.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::isPrintXMP
functions.signature: static bool Exiv2::Image::isPrintXMP(uint16_t type, Exiv2::PrintStructureOption option)
functions.description: Return whether XMP-related content should be printed for the given tag/type and print option.
requirements: type is a tag/type code relevant to printing logic.
option controls printing level; supply consistent value.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::isPrintICC
functions.signature: static bool Exiv2::Image::isPrintICC(uint16_t type, Exiv2::PrintStructureOption option)
functions.description: Return whether ICC profile-related content should be printed for the given tag/type and print option.
requirements: type is a tag/type code relevant to printing logic.
option controls printing level; supply consistent value.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::byteSwap
functions.signature: static uint64_t Exiv2::Image::byteSwap(uint64_t value, bool bSwap)
functions.description: Conditionally byte-swap a 64-bit integer depending on bSwap.
requirements: Provide the input in host endianness; bSwap selects whether to swap.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::byteSwap
functions.signature: static uint32_t Exiv2::Image::byteSwap(uint32_t value, bool bSwap)
functions.description: Conditionally byte-swap a 32-bit integer depending on bSwap.
requirements: Provide the input in host endianness; bSwap selects whether to swap.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::byteSwap
functions.signature: static uint16_t Exiv2::Image::byteSwap(uint16_t value, bool bSwap)
functions.description: Conditionally byte-swap a 16-bit integer depending on bSwap.
requirements: Provide the input in host endianness; bSwap selects whether to swap.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::byteSwap2
functions.signature: static uint16_t Exiv2::Image::byteSwap2(const Exiv2::DataBuf& buf, size_t offset, bool bSwap)
functions.description: Read a 2-byte value from buf at offset and optionally byte-swap it.
requirements: buf must contain at least offset + 2 bytes.
bSwap selects whether to swap based on source vs. host endianness.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::byteSwap4
functions.signature: static uint32_t Exiv2::Image::byteSwap4(const Exiv2::DataBuf& buf, size_t offset, bool bSwap)
functions.description: Read a 4-byte value from buf at offset and optionally byte-swap it.
requirements: buf must contain at least offset + 4 bytes.
bSwap selects whether to swap based on source vs. host endianness.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::byteSwap8
functions.signature: static uint64_t Exiv2::Image::byteSwap8(const Exiv2::DataBuf& buf, size_t offset, bool bSwap)
functions.description: Read an 8-byte value from buf at offset and optionally byte-swap it.
requirements: buf must contain at least offset + 8 bytes.
bSwap selects whether to swap based on source vs. host endianness.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::byteOrder
functions.description: Return the current byte order setting for encoding Exif metadata. Initially invalidByteOrder until determined or set.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::good
functions.description: Check whether the Image instance is in a valid state after construction.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::mimeType
functions.description: Return the MIME type for the specific image format handled by the subclass.
requirements: None for callers; concrete subclasses implement.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::pixelWidth
functions.description: Return the pixel width of the image, if known.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::pixelHeight
functions.description: Return the pixel height of the image, if known.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::comment
functions.description: Return a copy of the buffered image comment (may be empty).

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::io
functions.description: Return a reference to the BasicIo used by this Image for I/O. Useful to access modified image data (e.g., when using MemIo).
requirements: If the returned BasicIo is used to write directly, the Image will not reflect changes until readMetadata() is called.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::checkMode
functions.description: Return the access mode (supported metadata functions) for the given metadata type on this image instance.
requirements: metadataId must be a valid metadata identifier supported by the library.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::supportsMetadata
functions.description: Deprecated: Check whether this image supports a particular metadata type. Prefer checkMode().
requirements: metadataId must be a valid metadata identifier.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::nativePreviews
functions.description: Return the list of native previews extracted from the image. Intended for internal use by PreviewManager.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid while the Image object is alive and preview list is not modified.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::setTypeSupported
functions.description: Set the image type and its supported metadata bitmap for this instance (used by format implementations).
requirements: imageType must be a valid Exiv2::ImageType.
supportedMetadata is a bitmap of supported metadata types.

functions.name: Exiv2::Image::imageType
functions.description: Return the current image type associated with this Image instance.

functions.name: Exiv2::ImageFactory::createIo
functions.signature: static std::unique_ptr<Exiv2::BasicIo> Exiv2::ImageFactory::createIo(const std::string& path, bool useCurl = true)

requirements: buf must point to a readable memory region of at least size bytes containing JPEG image data.

Existing additional Exif thumbnail tags are not modified.

functions.description: Decodes Exif metadata from a binary buffer starting with a TIFF header into exifData and returns the byte order used in the data.

exifData will be modified to contain parsed tags.

functions.name: Exiv2::ExifParser::encode
functions.signature: Exiv2::WriteMethod Exiv2::ExifParser::encode(Exiv2::Blob& blob, const Exiv2::byte* pData, size_t size, Exiv2::ByteOrder byteOrder, Exiv2::ExifData& exifData)
functions.description: Encodes ExifData into binary Exif format. Attempts non-intrusive in-place update of pData/size when possible; otherwise writes a rebuilt Exif block into blob. Returns the method used (wmNonIntrusive or wmIntrusive).

requirements: blob will be replaced with the generated Exif block.
byteOrder specifies output endianness.
